fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 6% of monthly Gross Sales, due the 10th of each month. Advertising Fund is up to 4.5% of monthly Gross Sales, currently assessed at 2%. Cooperative Advertising Program is currently not assessed but may be up to 2% of Gross Sales when assessed. Computer Systems/Maintenance fee is currently not assessed. Additional training fees up to $4,000 per person (currently $1,500). Transfer Fee is $10,000. Successor Franchise fee is $10,000. Relocation fee currently $10,000.
raw_excerpt:
Royalty Fee | 6% of monthly Gross Sales | 10th day of each month to include sales for the previous calendar month | See Note 1
Advertising Fund | Up to 4.5% of monthly Gross Sales, currently 2% | 10th day of each month to include sales for the previous calendar month | See Note 2 and Item 11, Advertising Fund
Cooperative Advertising Program | Currently not assessed, but when assessed, up to 2% of Gross Sales | As required by the Cooperative to which the Restaurant belongs. | See Item 11, Cooperative Advertising Program
Additional, new, or repeat Initial Training Attendees | Our then-current initial training fee, up to $4,000 per person. Currently $1,500 per person (or $2,000 for an expelled trainee re-attending) | Prior to beginning of training | See Note 3
Additional Training or Assistance | Our then-current applicable daily rate, up to $800 per person per day. Currently $400 per person per day for services we provide at our training location and $600 per person per day plus expenses for training at your Restaurant. | Prior to beginning of training | Additional training may include refresher training we require and additional assistance or training you request.
Successor Franchise | $10,000 | Upon execution of a franchise agreement for successor franchise |
Transfer Fee | $10,000, subject to state law | Before completion of transfer | See Note 4
Product and Service Purchases | Actual Cost | As incurred | See Note 5 and Item 8
Testing | $3,000 | When billed | Covers the costs of testing new products or inspecting new suppliers you propose
Relocation | Our then-current relocation fee, currently $10,000 | As incurred | Due if you wish to relocate your Restaurant.
Computer Systems, Maintenance, | Not currently assessed | As incurred | See Note 6
